question: The word "subsume" means:
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. To absorb or include.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"subsume"** means:

 
 
• To absorb or include something into a larger category or framework. (शामिल करना या समाहित करना)
 
 
 
• **Example:** The small company was subsumed under the larger corporation.
 
• **"Correct answer"** means:
 
 
• Referring to the specific answer that properly defines or fits the context of the question. (सही उत्तर)
 
 
 
• **Example:** The correct answer to the quiz question assured her a perfect score.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **To absorb or include**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **To reject** (अस्वीकार करना): To refuse to accept, believe, or use something.

 
 
• **Example:** She decided to reject the job offer because the salary was too low.
 
 
 
• **To separate** (अलग करना): To cause something to be apart or placed apart from others.
 
 
• **Example:** He used a filter to separate the fine particles from the water.
 
 
 
• **To delay** (विलंब करना): To postpone or defer an action or event.
 
 
• **Example:** The flight was delayed due to bad weather.
